column1: # Waaiya city list. Source: Natural Earth 1:10m Cultural Vectors, Populated Places (ne_10m_populated_places.geojson, v5.1.2, natural-earth-vector commit 789c990, file sha256 9b8e3de09048ef00dfc70357dbb9fa324493f214b5e0ae4daf1aa79a8d10116b), https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_10m_populated_places.geojson ; licence: public domain (Natural Earth); fetched 2026-11-20. Rows selected and lightly edited by hand (Arabic names of Arab-world and holy cities, some English names, country codes for -99 places, time zones assigned per city and checked against IANA tzdata 2019c). Columns as named on the next line; alt = other English spellings to search by (added by hand).
# The 'Jerusalem' row has country code PS and its Persian and Urdu names were changed to قدس and بیت المقدس by hand.

# Morocco (and Ceuta, Melilla): the 190 cities of the Ministry of Habous's prayer times (habous.gov.ma), Arabic names as the ministry writes them, Latin names in scripts/habous/names.tsv, positions and horizons (rise, set: degrees below the horizon for sunrise and Maghrib) fitted to the ministry's published tables by scripts/habous/make_habous.py; habous = the ministry's city code.
